full_name: Junot Díaz | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: At the Radcliffe Institute, Junot Díaz will be writing a novel, “﻿The Guilty Country,” set in a not-so-distant United States where the civil-rights movements of the sixties and seventies were destroyed by martial law.
